arxiv-1809-09371.title: S. Acharya
arxiv-1809-09371.description: Abstract The production yield of prompt D mesons and their elliptic flow coefficient v 2 v_{2} were measured with the Event-Shape Engineering (ESE) technique applied to mid-central (10–30% and 30–50% centrality classes) Pb–Pb collisions at the centre-of-mass energy per nucleon pair s NN = 5.02 \sqrt{s_{\rm\scriptscriptstyle NN}}=5.02 TeV, with the ALICE detector at the LHC.

arxiv-2012-00359.title: Insiders and their Free Lunches: the Role of Short Positions
arxiv-2012-00359.creator: Delia Coculescu, Aditi Dandapani
arxiv-2012-00359.description: Abstract . Given a stock price process, we analyse the potential of arbitrage in a context of short-selling prohibitions. We introduce the notion of minimal supermartingale measure, and we analyse its properties in connection to the minimal martingale measure. This question is more specifically analysed in the case of an investor having additional, inside information.

arxiv-2104-11999.title: Extreme HBL-like behavior of Markarian 421 and its two-zone photohadronic interpretation
arxiv-2104-11999.creator: Sarira Sahu, Carlos E. López Fortín, Isabel Abigail Valadez Polanco, Subhash Rajpoot
arxiv-2104-11999.description: Abstract Markarian 421 is the nearest high-energy peaked blazar and also is the first extragalactic source to be detected in multi-TeV γ \gamma -rays. It has been observed in multiwavelength for exceptionally long period of time with dense monitoring and several major outbursts have been detected from this source.

arxiv-2107-04158.title: FORCAST imaging of two small nearby clusters: the Coronet and B 59
arxiv-2107-04158.creator: Göran Sandell, Bo Reipurth, William D. Vacca, Naman S. Bajaj
arxiv-2107-04158.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Göran Sandell, Bo Reipurth, William D. Vacca, Naman S. Bajaj. We present mid infrared imaging of two young clusters, the Coronet in the CrA cloud core and B 59 in the Pipe Nebula, using the FORCAST camera on the Stratospheric Observatory for Infrared Astronomy. We also analyze Herschel Space Observatory 1 1 1 Herschel is an ESA space observatory with science instruments provided by European-led Principal Investigator consortia and with important participation from NASA. PACS and SPIRE images of the associated clouds.

arxiv-2108-02960.title: A well balanced finite volume scheme for general relativity
arxiv-2108-02960.creator: Elena Gaburro, Manuel J. Castro, Michael Dumbser
arxiv-2108-02960.description: Abstract In this work we present a novel second order accurate well balanced (WB) finite volume (FV) scheme for the solution of the general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics (GRMHD) equations and the first order CCZ4 formulation (FO-CCZ4) of the Einstein field equations of general relativity, as well as the fully coupled FO-CCZ4 + GRMHD system.

arxiv-2209-02175.title: The Stellar-mass Function of Long Gamma-Ray Burst Host Galaxies
arxiv-2209-02175.creator: Guang-Xuan Lan, Jun-Jie Wei, Ye Li, Hou-Dun Zeng, Xue-Feng Wu
arxiv-2209-02175.description: Abstract Long gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) have been discussed as a potential tool to probe the cosmic star formation rate (SFR) for a long time. Some studies found an enhancement in the GRB rate relative to the galaxy-inferred SFR at high redshifts, which indicates that GRBs may not be good tracers of star formation.

arxiv-2210-16323.title: Symmetry protected topological phases under decoherence
arxiv-2210-16323.creator: Jong Yeon Lee, Yi-Zhuang You, Cenke Xu
arxiv-2210-16323.description: Abstract We investigate mixed states exhibiting nontrivial topological features, focusing on symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases under various types of decoherence. Our findings demonstrate that these systems can retain topological information from the SPT ground state despite decoherence. In the ”doubled Hilbert space,” we define symmetry-protected topological ensembles (SPT ensembles) and examine boundary anomalies in this space.

arxiv-2301-07991.title: Introducing memory to a family of multi-step multidimensional iterative methods with weight function
arxiv-2301-07991.creator: Alicia Cordero, Eva G. Villalba, Juan R. Torregrosa, Paula Triguero-Navarro
arxiv-2301-07991.description: Abstract In this paper, we construct a derivative-free multi-step iterative scheme based on Steffensen’s method. To avoid excessively increasing the number of functional evaluations and, at the same time, to increase the order of convergence, we freeze the divided differences used from the second step and use a weight function on already evaluated operators.

arxiv-2304-03688.title: Graph Parameters, Universal Obstructions, and WQO Thanks: All authors are supported by the French-German Collaboration ANR/DFG Project UTMA (ANR-20-CE92-0027). The third author is also supported by the MEAE and the MESR, via the Franco-Norwegian project PHC Aurora project n. 51260WL (2024).
arxiv-2304-03688.creator: Christophe Paul, Evangelos Protopapas, Dimitrios M. Thilikos
arxiv-2304-03688.description: Abstract We establish a parametric framework for obtaining obstruction characterizations of graph parameters with respect to a quasi-ordering ⩽ \leqslant on graphs. At the center of this framework lies the concept of a ⩽ \leqslant -parametric graph : a non ⩽ \leqslant -decreasing sequence 𝒢 = ⟨ 𝒢 t ⟩ t ∈ ℕ \mathscr{G}=\langle\mathscr{G}_{t}\rangle_{t\in\mathbb{N}} of graphs indexed by non-negative integers.

arxiv-2402-13950.title: Making Reasoning Matter: Measuring and Improving Faithfulness of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
arxiv-2402-13950.creator: Debjit Paul, Robert West, Antoine Bosselut, Boi Faltings
arxiv-2402-13950.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Debjit Paul, Robert West, Antoine Bosselut, Boi Faltings. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to perform better when asked to reason step-by-step before answering a question. However, it is unclear to what degree the model’s final answer is faithful to the stated reasoning steps.

arxiv-2404-19428.title: From Quantum Mechanics to Quantum Software Engineering: A Historical Review
arxiv-2404-19428.creator: Giuseppe Bisicchia, Jose Garcia-Alonso, Juan M. Murillo, Antonio Brogi
arxiv-2404-19428.description: Abstract Victor Hugo’s timeless observation, ‘Nothing is more powerful than an idea whose time has come’ , resonates today as Quantum Computing, once only a dream of a physicist, stands at the threshold of reality with the potential to revolutionise the world.

arxiv-2411-08796.title: Optimal stopping for Markov processes with positive jumps
arxiv-2411-08796.creator: Fabián Crocce, Ernesto Mordecki
arxiv-2411-08796.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Fabián Crocce, Ernesto Mordecki. Consider the discounted optimal stopping problem for a real valued Markov process with only positive jumps. We provide a theorem to verify that the optimal stopping region has the form { x ≥ x ∗ } \{x\geq x^{*}\} for some critical threshold x ∗ x^{*} , and a representation formula for the value function of the problem in terms of the Green kernel of the process, based on Dynkin’s characterization of the value function as the least excessive majorant.

arxiv-2501-10346.title: Normal forms and geometric structures on Hopf manifolds
arxiv-2501-10346.creator: Paul Boureau
arxiv-2501-10346.description: Abstract . We prove that every Hopf manifold of dimension n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 , primary or secondary, admits a holomorphic ( G , X ) (G,X) -structure compatible with its complex structure, where X = 𝐂 n X=\mathbf{C}^{n} and G G is generated by the translations and the Guysinsky–Katok group of invertible sub-resonant polynomials.

arxiv-2501-18272.title: The Periodic Table and the Group SO ⁡ ( 4 , 4 ) \SO(4,4)
arxiv-2501-18272.creator: V. V. Varlamov
arxiv-2501-18272.description: Abstract The periodic system of chemical elements is represented within the framework of the weight diagram of the Lie algebra of the fourth rank of the rotation group of an eight-dimensional pseudo-Euclidean space. The hydrogen realization of the Cartan subalgebra and Weyl generators of the group algebra is studied.

arxiv-2506-08252.title: PoSyn: Secure Power Side-Channel Aware Synthesis
arxiv-2506-08252.creator: Amisha Srivastava 1 , Samit S. Miftah 1 , Hyunmin Kim 2 , Debjit Pal 3 , Kanad Basu 1
arxiv-2506-08252.description: Abstract Power Side-Channel (PSC) attacks exploit power consumption patterns to extract sensitive information, posing risks to cryptographic operations crucial for secure systems. Traditional countermeasures, such as masking, face challenges like complex synthesis integration, high area overhead, and vulnerability to optimization removal during logic synthesis.

arxiv-2602-16308.title: Markerless Robot Detection and 6D Pose Estimation for Multi-Agent SLAM
arxiv-2602-16308.creator: Markus Rüggeberg, Maximilian Ulmer, Maximilian Durner, Wout Boerdijk, Marcus Müller, Rudolph Triebel, Riccardo Giubilato
arxiv-2602-16308.description: Abstract The capability of multi-robot SLAM approaches to merge localization history and maps from different observers is often challenged by the difficulty in establishing data association. Loop closure detection between perceptual inputs of different robotic agents is easily compromised in the context of perceptual aliasing, or when perspectives differ significantly.

plos-pone-0011352.creator: Yacine Kharraz, Pierre-Adrien Salmand, Anne Camus et al.
plos-pone-0011352.description: PLOS ONE research article. TIA-1-related (TIAR) protein is a shuttling RNA-binding protein involved in several steps of RNA metabolism. While in the nucleus TIAR participates to alternative splicing events, in the cytoplasm TIAR acts as a translational repressor on specific transcripts such as those contai

pmc-10643087.title: Adult spinal deformity: Past, present & future
pmc-10643087.creator: Ahmet Alanay
pmc-10643087.description: underscoring its profound health implications, surpassing those of other chronic diseases such as heart and lung conditions, as well as limitations in the use of limbs. Our approach to addressing the ASD epidemic has undergone significant transformations. Our understanding of spinal deformities has evolved from pediatric coronal plane analysis to a focus on sagittal plane issues in adult patients.

pmc-10736369.title: CATCHU: A NOVEL VISUAL-SOMATOSENSORY INTEGRATION TOOL FOR PREDICTING FALLS
pmc-10736369.creator: Jeannette Mahoney, Claudene George, Joe Verghese
pmc-10736369.description: Ability to integrate information across sensory systems is a vital aspect of human functioning in the real world. While multisensory integration effects are measured across a wide array of populations using various sensory pairings and different neuroscience techniques, a gold standard for quantifying multisensory integration was seemingly lacking.

pmc-11443567.title: Characterization of quorum regulatory small RNAs in an emerging pathogen Vibrio fluvialis and their roles toward type VI secretion system VflT6SS2 modulation
pmc-11443567.creator: Anran Zhang, Yue Xiao, Yu Han, Yuanming Huang, Biao Kan, Weili Liang
pmc-11443567.description: The type VI secretion system (T6SS) is essential for Gram-negative bacteria to antagonize a wide variety of prokaryotic and eukaryotic competitors and thus gain survival advantages. Two sets of T6SS have been found in Vibrio fluvialis, namely VflT6SS1 and VflT6SS2, among which VflT6SS2 is functionally expressed.

pmc-11644559.title: The Role of Vitamin E Isoforms and Metabolites in Cancer Prevention: Mechanistic Insights into Sphingolipid Metabolism Modulation
pmc-11644559.creator: Yumi Jang, Choon Young Kim, Alan Stewart
pmc-11644559.description: Natural forms of vitamin E include four tocopherols and four tocotrienols (α, β, γ, and δ), which are essential as lipophilic antioxidants. Among these eight isoforms, α-tocopherol (αT), the predominant form of vitamin E found in tissues, has traditionally received the most attention in disease prevention research due to its robust antioxidant activity.

pmc-12468963.title: Multi-UAV-Assisted ISAC System: Joint User Association, Trajectory Design, and Resource Allocation
pmc-12468963.creator: Jinwei Wang, Renhui Xu, Laixian Peng, Xianglin Wei
pmc-12468963.description: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-assisted integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems have developed rapidly in the sixth generation (6G) era. However, factors such as the mobility of ground users and malicious jamming pose significant challenges to systems’ performance and reliability. Against this backdrop, this paper designs a multi-UAV-assisted ISAC system model under malicious jamming environments.

pmc-12473202.title: Comprehensive Review of Open-Source Fundus Image Databases for Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis
pmc-12473202.creator: Valérian Conquer, Thomas Lambolais, Gustavo Andrade-Miranda, Baptiste Magnier, Bogdan Smolka
pmc-12473202.description: Databases play a crucial role in training, validating, and comparing AI models for detecting retinal diseases, as well as in clinical research, technology development, and healthcare professional training. Diabetic retinopathy (DR), a common diabetes complication, is a leading cause of vision impairment and blindness worldwide. Early detection and management are essential to prevent irreversible vision loss.

pmc-12491192.title: Unpacking the cost implications of diagnosis-related groups reform for lumbar disc herniation patients in Chinese medicine: a closer look at evidence from China
pmc-12491192.creator: Meng-en Chen, Yu-han Wang, Jing Yu, Shi-ji Xia, Xiao-xi Zhang, Yan Wang, You-shu Yuan, Xuan Jia, He-nong Sun, Guo-ping Wu, Jia-yi Wang, Tian-zhen Cong, Fan-xin Kong, Hao-jia Hou, Jing-yu Yang, Zhi-wei Wang
pmc-12491192.description: ObjectivesLumbar disc herniation (LDH) presents a significant economic burden globally, worsening in China due to an aging population. Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) offers effective treatment options for LDH, making its integration with Diagnosis-Related Groups (DRG) payment reform crucial for reducing medical costs and enhancing healthcare quality.

pmc-12511331.title: Photocatalytic streamlined dual-functional group transfer from cyanopyridine to internal alkynes
pmc-12511331.creator: Xiaogang Tong, Jialong Jie, Yan Liu, Haihan Yu, Mingquan Yuan, Hwee Ting Ang, Gan Wang, Duanshuai Tian, Hongmei Su, Jie Wu
pmc-12511331.description: The streamlined dual-functional group transfer (streamlined dual-FGT) strategy represents an efficient and sustainable approach for difunctionalization reactions, where all atoms or functional groups from the starting materials are fully incorporated into the final products without generating by-products. Pyridine and nitrile functionalities are prevalent and highly valued structural motifs found in a myriad of natural products, pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and polymers.

pmc-13076172.title: Case Report: The diagnostic and therapeutic crossroads: when myelofibrosis transforms into mixed phenotype acute leukemia
pmc-13076172.creator: Yanquan Liu, Jingdong Zhang, Xiangzhou Du, Lihong Liao
pmc-13076172.description: BackgroundMyelofibrosis (MF) is a myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by the proliferation of fibrous tissue in the bone marrow. Transformation to acute leukemia, typically acute myeloid leukemia, represents a terminal event in its natural history; however, transformation to mixed phenotype acute leukemia (MPAL) is exceedingly rare. The diagnosis and treatment of MPAL are particularly challenging, especially in elderly patients with underlying MF.

pmc-13145331.title: Environmental drivers of metapopulation dynamics throughout the full annual cycle in a declining Arctic‐nesting migratory herbivore
pmc-13145331.creator: Alexander R. Schindler, Anthony D. Fox, Alyn J. Walsh, Larry R. Griffin, Seán B. A. Kelly, Mitch D. Weegman
pmc-13145331.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13199396.title: The future of digital innovation in transforming food safety systems in the developing world
pmc-13199396.creator: Gabor Molnar
pmc-13199396.description: Low- and middle-income countries bear the most significant burden of foodborne diseases, impacting their food and nutrition security, trade, and ultimately economic growth. Recent advances in digitization and artificial intelligence provide new opportunities to transform food safety systems, addressing inefficiencies through better oversight and improved decision-making.

pmc-13316636.title: Precision prebiotics: Engineering food-derived polysaccharides to target specific SCFA-producing taxa for neuroprotection via the microbiota-gut-brain axis

pmc-13334478.title: Aggregation and surface-state modulated fluorescence quenching of lemon-derived carbon quantum dots for the sensitive detection of 4-aminophenol
pmc-13334478.creator: Unzila Saeed, Sunnia Tariq, Sara Riaz, Muhammad Nasir, Usman Latif, Akhtar Hayat, Cong Kong, Mian Hasnain Nawaz
pmc-13334478.description: 4-Aminophenol (4-AP) is the primary degradation product of paracetamol (PA), resulting from its hydrolytic cleavage within the human body and is known for its nephrotoxic, hepatotoxic, and teratogenic nature. Its enhanced levels may cause mutagenic responses and DNA damage in living organisms; therefore, the accurate detection of 4-AP is important for public health monitoring.
